data.name: Settings_OneTaskPerFolder
data.value: One task at a time per folder

data.name: Settings_OneTaskPerFolder_Hint
data.value: Stop a task launching while another is still working in the same folder. A task holds its folder until it is completed. A single task can be allowed to run alongside the others from its own page.

data.name: Settings_PauseAutoExecution_Hint
data.value: Nothing starts on its own while this is on, whatever a task is scheduled for. Launching a task by hand still works.

data.name: Settings_MaxConcurrent_Hint
data.value: How many tasks the queue keeps working at the same time. Each one holds a live agent and its terminal, so this is a real ceiling on the machine. A task waiting to be signed off does not count.

data.name: Settings_UsageCeiling_Hint
data.value: Once a 5-hour or weekly quota reaches this much, auto-execution waits for the window to reset. Below that, tasks launch as usual. Under 100% on purpose: the reading is up to three minutes old and rounded to a whole percent, and a task launched into the last of a quota stops mid-run rather than failing cleanly. Set it lower to keep more of the quota for your own sessions. Manual launches are never held.

data.name: Settings_AutoArchive_Hint
data.value: A signed-off task leaves the board once it is old enough. Nothing is destroyed — it moves to the archive, where you can restore it.

data.name: Settings_AutoArchiveDays_Hint
data.value: Days since the task was completed. A task you restore by hand stays on the board.
